As a {ref:glossary/bonus-action}, you can strike terror into others with your menacing presence and primal power. When you do so, each creature of your choice in a 30-foot Emanation originating from you must make a Wisdom saving throw (DC 8 plus your Strength modifier and Proficiency Bonus). On a failed save, a creature has the {ref:condition/frightened} condition for 1 minute. At the end of each of the {ref:condition/frightened} creature's turns, the creature repeats the save, ending the effect on itself on a success.

Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a {ref:glossary/long-rest} unless you expend a use of your Rage (no action required) to restore your use of it.
